svg.title: Issue 5 — Page 1 — Panel 1: Briefing — Wren projects the holographic schematic — squad assembling around it
svg.desc: 28mm establishing wide. Wall-cavity camp interior between timber beams. Wren center, hands raised, copper-gold schematic blooming between her palms. Squad arranging. Cool perimeter glow + warm floorboard leak + new copper-gold from schematic. The moment a mission begins.
svg.text: Target: Hoskins and Sons, horology and fine clockwork.
One precision gear assembly. Swiss. Third shelf, display clock.
